search_text: published ZDI-07-007 ZDI-CAN-112 Hewlett-Packard Mercury LoadRunner Agent Stack Overflow Vulnerability 2007-02-08 CVE-2007-0446 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2007-0446 ['Mercury Mercury Mercury'] ['Performance Center Monitor over Firewall LoadRunner'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Hewlett-Packard Mercury LoadRunner Agent, Mercury Performance Center Agent and Mercury Monitor over Firewall. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the process magentproc.exe that binds to TCP port 54345. When parsing packets containing an overly long 'server_ip_name' field, an exploitable stack overflow may be triggered due to an an inline strcpy() within the library mchan.dll. Mercury has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
